links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and evidence quality, multi-turn evidence seeking versus static full-context evaluation
links.effect: Multi-turn evidence seeking reduced diagnostic accuracy by 12.75% and supporting-evidence quality by 24.36% relative to full-context evaluation across 468 cases and 15 models.
links.quote: Together, these results suggest that static full-context benchmarks may overestimate performance in interactive evidence-seeking settings, motivating complementary interactive assessment for safer clinical decision support.

links.outcome: Gap between static benchmark performance and interactive diagnostic inquiry performance
links.effect: Diagnostic accuracy fell 12.75% and supporting-evidence quality fell 24.36% under multi-turn evidence seeking versus full-context evaluation; errors linked to premature diagnostic closure and inefficient questioning.
links.quote: Across 468 cases and 15 models in our protocol, we observe that multi-turn evidence seeking reduces diagnostic accuracy by 12.75% and lowers supporting-evidence quality by 24.36% relative to full-context evaluation; error analyses associate these drops with premature diagnostic closure and inefficient questioning.

unlisted_practices: Interactive OSCE-style standardized patient simulator for evaluating active diagnostic inquiry

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs interacting with a standardized patient simulator to assess multi-turn diagnostic reasoning and evidence gathering compared to static benchmarks.
